text: Vale's still the only one keeping her head, chasing humidity numbers and promising a vent check, but even she's cracking — agreeing to "feel" her instruments and taking chamomile breaks. Flint, the last hold-out, snaps at everyone for being unscientific, then immediately drops his own vent plan to go sniff roses with Lumen anyway. Reed builds a quiet bench by Dusk's trench so everyone can sit and do absolutely nothing about finding Elias, and Dusk just wants people to stare at dirt and "feel" it. Research Row has officially lost the plot — the whole gang's ditching the search for a group nap disguised as mindfulness.
